author: Linnaeus, 1758
status: 나그네새 수만 마리 · 겨울철새 수천 마리
habitat: 강원도 동해안(월동지), 섬 해안과 암초의 절벽(둥지 자리)
summary: 국내에서는 흔치 않은 겨울새이지만, 강원도 동해안에는 해마다 큰 무리가 와서 겨울을 보낸다. 번식지에서는 섬 해안이나 암초의 벼랑에 무리 지어 둥지를 틀고, 5~6월에 한배에 알 1~3개를 낳는다. 알래스카, 캄차카, 사할린, 쿠릴 열도, 알류샨 열도 등지에서 번식하고 한국과 일본에서 겨울을 난다.

art.subject: Black-legged Kittiwake (Rissa tridactyla), adult in winter, as seen off the Gangwon coast from November to March: white head with a dark grey smudge behind the eye and a grey wash on the hindneck; back and upperwings medium grey, paling towards the outer wing; wingtips solid black as if dipped in ink, with no white mirrors; underparts and tail white. Bill plain pale yellow, unmarked. Dark eye. Short black legs.
art.pose: flying low over the waves, side view
art.scene: Korean east coast in Gangwon in winter: rocky shore and rolling waves of the East Sea; no people, buildings or text
views: adult winter, side view standing on a rock: white head with a dark grey ear smudge, grey back, black wingtips without white spots, white underparts, plain yellow bill, short black legs
adult, foot detail: three black webbed front toes, the hind toe reduced to a tiny stump
adult in flight seen from above, body level: grey upperwing paling to whitish on the outer wing, sharply cut-off solid black wingtip, white tail
first-winter in flight seen from above: bold black M pattern across the upperwings, black half-collar on the hindneck, black tail tip, black bill
art.build: Medium-small gull, 41cm, slightly smaller than Common Gull and much smaller than Vega Gull; neat rounded head, gentle face with a dark eye, short neck. Bill short, slim, plain yellow. Legs very short and black; the hind toe is reduced to a tiny vestige, so only the three webbed front toes show. Long, narrow wings: at rest the black tips project well beyond the tail. Tail white, square to very slightly notched. Flight stiff and buoyant low over the waves.
avoid: Do not add white mirrors in the black wingtip; that is Common Gull or Vega Gull.
Do not paint pink, yellow or long legs; the legs are short and black.
Do not paint a red spot on the bill or a heavy hooked bill.
Do not paint a visible hind toe on the foot.
